## Outcome

Describe the user-visible behavior or maintenance result and why it is needed.

## Safety and compatibility

- Does this mutate Git state, history, refs, worktrees, configuration, provider state, or plugin state?
- What confirmation, cancellation, sanitization, and authoritative refresh behavior applies?
- Does this change configuration schema, plugin API, keybindings, commands, or supported platforms?

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and keymap/configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] Platform/operator validation is attached or explicitly marked unverified.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, fixtures, and recordings contain no credentials or private repository data.

## Evidence

List exact commands, results, recordings, or CI links.
